an4.236:1.1: imāni bhikkhave kammāni mayā . . . paveditāni. Katamāni cattāri? Atthi bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ . . . pe . . . kammaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattati.
an4.236:2.1: Katamañ ca bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ? Idha bhikkhave ekacco mātā-jīvitā voropitā hoti, pitā-jīvitā voropitā hoti, arahaṃ-jīvitā voropitā hoti, Tathāgatassa paduṭṭhena cittena lohitaṃ uppāditā hoti, saṅgho pi bhinno hoti. Idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ.
